\begin{example} \end{example}[Margulis tube as a quotient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0211 1. ch31:31.45\group Margulis lemma

The change of variables $y'=e^s x$, $y^n=e^s$ identifies the upper half-space metric with $\sum _i(x^i ds+dx^i)^2+ds^2$, and a tube is the quotient of $B^{n-1}(r)\times \mathbb R$ by $s\mapsto s+\ell $. \end{example}
